pages.text: The hut's carvings wake when set in the ground. I cannot make their like. But a $(item)splinter$() of any log, cut the same way round a shard of amethyst, carries enough of it.

pages.title: Two Hands
pages.text: So everything on this estate is made by two hands. The heart of each post is the hut's, old and odd. The rest is mine: squared timber, black iron, a page of this ledger and my seal.$(br2)I do not understand the first hand. I only keep good accounts of what it does.
